title: Incognito Mode Privacy Hardening Checklist
metaDescription: Complete checklist to maximize privacy in incognito mode across all browsers. Learn essential steps to enhance private browsing security.
intro: Incognito mode provides basic privacy protection, but it's not bulletproof. This checklist helps you maximize your privacy when using private browsing across different browsers and scenarios.

items.task: Enable incognito mode in your browser
items.why: Prevents local storage of browsing history, cookies, and form data on your device.
items.howTo: Press Ctrl+Shift+N (Chrome), Ctrl+Shift+P (Firefox), or Ctrl+Shift+N (Edge). On mobile, tap the tabs button and select 'Incognito' or 'Private'.

items.task: Close all regular browsing tabs before going incognito
items.why: Prevents accidental cross-contamination between regular and private sessions.
items.howTo: Close all non-incognito tabs or use a separate browser window entirely for private browsing sessions.

items.task: Confirm incognito mode visual indicators are active
items.why: Ensures you're actually in private browsing mode and not accidentally browsing normally.
items.howTo: Look for dark theme, incognito icon, or 'Private' label in the address bar. Each browser has distinct visual cues.

items.why: Extensions can track your activity even in private browsing mode unless specifically blocked.
items.howTo: Go to browser settings > Extensions. Disable 'Allow in incognito' for all extensions, or use Incognito Browser which blocks extensions by default.

items.task: Block location access in incognito mode
items.why: Prevents websites from tracking your physical location during private browsing sessions.
items.howTo: Go to browser settings > Privacy > Location. Set to 'Block' or 'Ask before accessing' for incognito mode specifically.

items.why: Protects against unauthorized audio/video recording during private browsing.
items.howTo: In browser settings > Privacy, set microphone and camera permissions to 'Block' for incognito sessions.

items.task: Clear DNS cache before incognito sessions
items.why: Removes traces of previously visited websites that could compromise your privacy.
items.howTo: Run 'ipconfig /flushdns' in Windows Command Prompt or 'sudo dscacheutil -flushcache' on Mac before starting private browsing.

items.why: Prevents your ISP from logging DNS queries and adds an extra layer of privacy protection.
items.howTo: Set DNS to 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) or 8.8.8.8 (Google) in your network settings, or use Incognito Browser with built-in DNS protection.

items.task: Avoid logging into personal accounts in incognito mode
items.why: Logging in defeats the purpose of private browsing as it directly identifies you to websites.
items.howTo: Use incognito mode only for anonymous browsing. If you must log in, consider the session no longer truly private.

items.task: Close incognito tabs immediately after use
items.why: Minimizes the window of opportunity for data collection and ensures session data is cleared.
items.howTo: Close individual tabs with Ctrl+W or close entire incognito window with Alt+F4 to end the private session completely.

items.task: Restart browser between sensitive incognito sessions
items.why: Ensures complete memory cleanup and prevents any potential data leakage between sessions.
items.howTo: Completely close and reopen your browser between different private browsing activities, especially for sensitive tasks.

items.why: Prevents other apps from potentially monitoring or interfering with your private browsing session.
items.howTo: Close social media apps, messaging clients, and other unnecessary software before starting sensitive incognito sessions.
